name: Leave Management Feature
description: Implements leave management including leave types, request submission, approval workflows, and balance tracking.
outputPattern: LeaveRequest model, API routes, and service layer
systemPromptAddition:
## Leave Management Skill
- Leave types: annual, sick, personal, unpaid, parental, bereavement
- Status flow: pending → approved/rejected → cancelled
- Include: employeeId, leaveType, startDate, endDate, reason, status, approverId
- Validate leave balance before approval
- Check for overlapping leave requests
- Auto-deduct balance upon approval
